heading: Articles
description: Write an article, then let the review flow publish or reject it.
policy: Submitting starts the article-publish flow: the article enters review, an agent reviews this exact revision, then exactly one branch runs — publish or reject. Even an approved review waits for a human confirmation before content becomes public. A published blocked-word list overrides the model: a match can never be approved for publishing. Published articles are immutable.
